events.description: Carol Willick asks where Ross Geller and Susan Bunch are right now.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is sure that Ross Geller and Susan Bunch will arrive here soon.
Monica Geller says Ross Geller and Susan Bunch will be here soon.
Rachel Green says Ross Geller and Susan Bunch would not miss Carol Willick giving birth to Ben Geller.
Joey Tribbiani tells Carol Willick to relax right now.
Joey Tribbiani says Carol Willick is currently dilated to nine centimeters.
Joey Tribbiani says Ben Geller is at zero station right now.
Chandler Bing says Joey Tribbiani is frightening Chandler Bing right now.
Chandler Bing asks that somebody help Chandler Bing right now.
Chandler Bing says somebody is trying to rip out Chandler Bing's heart right now.
Chandler Bing says that somebody trying to rip out Chandler Bing's heart is great.
Chandler Bing asks whether anybody has seen a nipple.
Dr. Franzblau says that Joey Tribbiani, Rachel Green, Dr. Franzblau, Monica Geller, Carol Willick, and Chandler Bing are starting the delivery now.
Nurse Sizemore tells Carol Willick to start pushing now.
Dr. Franzblau says Dr. Franzblau is sorry.
Dr. Franzblau says Dr. Franzblau cannot tell Ben Geller to wait for Ross Geller and Susan Bunch.
